Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the lineage, conflating Adam’s maternal grandfather with his maternal grandmother’s father. Despite evidence that Margo Howard’s father is Jules/Julius Lederer (which makes him Adam’s maternal grandfather), the Planner incorrectly concluded Abraham B. (A.B.) Friedman (Ann Landers’ father), which is actually Adam’s maternal great-grandfather, and prematurely marked the task complete.
